# Ethical Specialist Agent Architecture — Version 5

The Mars Harness Lab now includes an ethical, recursive specialist-agent organization for science, engineering, and project management.

The Mission Orchestrator routes work. Independent Ethics, Ground Truth, and Mission Memory controls span three accountable directors: Hypatia Science, Intelligent Engineer Systems, and PM Accelerator Program. Each director maintains a specialist bench and may create narrower, temporary subagents under a written spawn contract. The engineering organization includes 11 lifecycle agents and 34 discipline agents spanning systems, aerospace, propulsion, mechanical, structural, civil, electrical, electronics, embedded, communications, software and AI, controls and robotics, thermal, chemical/process, materials, biomedical, life support, nuclear/radiation, optics/sensors, manufacturing, quality, reliability, safety/cybersecurity, human factors, agriculture/food, mining/resources, drilling/subsurface, geospatial/survey, habitats/buildings, fire protection, acoustics/vibration, hydraulics/fluids, mechatronics/automation, and test/instrumentation.

Children inherit all scope, permission, evidence, safety, and ethics limits. Default maximum depth is three. Parents remain accountable, mission-critical work requires independent review, and children are retired when their return condition is met.

All agents must preserve human authority; protect life, privacy, security, rights, fairness, accessibility, scientific integrity, and the environment; disclose evidence status and uncertainty; use least privilege and reversible actions; preserve dissent; and refuse fabrication, deception, discriminatory optimization, unauthorized surveillance, unsafe autonomy, permission escalation, or concealment of material risk.

The independent Ethics, Safety, and Human Authority Council records `pass`, `conditional`, or `block`. No agent can waive the charter or approve its own high-risk work.

Full operating detail is in `skills/docs/ETHICAL_SPECIALIST_AGENT_ARCHITECTURE.md`, `skills/docs/ENGINEERING_DISCIPLINE_AGENT_CATALOG.md`, and `skills/ethical-specialist-agent-network/SKILL.md` in the complete package.
